full_title: DIY Perfume Making Kit Recipe | Lavender & Frankincense Roll-On | Natural Gift for Her | Digital Download
instructions: Pour 9.4ml jojoba oil into the 10ml roller bottle using the small funnel, leaving a little headroom.

Add the essential oil blend in this order: 3 drops Mandarin Essential Oil, 2 drops Petitgrain Essential Oil (top notes), then 4 drops Lavender Essential Oil, 4 drops Geranium Essential Oil (heart notes), then 1 drop Frankincense Essential Oil, 1 drop Myrrh Essential Oil, 1 drop Labdanum Absolute (base notes).
Cap the bottle tightly and roll it between your palms 20 times to blend everything evenly.
Label the bottle with the recipe name and date, then let the perfume rest for 48 hours before first use.
safety_notes: Keep essential oils and the finished fragrance out of reach of children and pets.
Patch test on a small area of skin before regular use.
Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.
Keep away from eyes and mucous membranes.
Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.
If pregnant, nursing, or under medical care, ask a healthcare provider before use.

Scent Profile

Heart: Lavender, Geranium
Base: Frankincense, Myrrh, Labdanum
The blend unfolds in layers — the top notes greet you first, the heart notes linger, and the base notes anchor the scent for hours.

How It Works
Gather your ingredients, measure, blend, and let the recipe rest. Hands-on time is about 15–20 minutes. This recipe makes 1 x 10ml roll-on bottle. Estimated cost to make: ~$5.24. Skill level: beginner — perfect for DIY perfume beginners and a thoughtful handmade gift for her — birthdays, bridesmaids, holidays.

Safety & Tips
- Keep essential oils and the finished fragrance out of reach of children and pets.
- Patch test on a small area of skin before regular use.
- Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.
- Keep away from eyes and mucous membranes.
- Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.
